x: In the 440 yards Dudley Gordon finished 2nd; John Davis won the 880 yards with George Davidson fourth. The two miles was won by Dave Baulch with Don Stroud 2nd and Dave Hooper 3rd.
John Davis who just escaped being boxed in the half mile heats, made no mistake in the final when he leapt away at the bell to win in 1m.55.9s.

The last heat gave John Davis a chance to show his paces, but Clark of Aylesbury opened a big gap in the third lap and before John could extricate himself from the rest of the field, Clark was too far away.
John Thresher was not at his best following an injury, and injury kept John Davis out of the team. Joe Dooley and Don MacLean completed our runners.
The indefatigable Paul Pringle was our next man home, a minute or so ahead of John Davis, of 1:52.8 880yds/4:10.6 mile fame some 17 years ago and here making his debut at the marathon.

PAM and JOHN DAVIS, another Selsonia Ladies AC/Belgrave partnership, are also doing their best to keep the Club stocked with thoroughbreds, and seven weeks after the arrival of another bouncing boy, Pam was out jogging again.
